children: SurgePays formed LWP-SURGE to serve as the operating vehicle for a proposed smartphone rent-to-own joint venture with LowWeeklyPayments.
SurgePays initiated articles of organization for LWP-SURGE, a Wyoming LLC, on Sept. 2, 2026 to house the proposed JV.
SurgePays expects a 51% membership interest and to manage LWP-SURGE; LWP would hold 49% and appoint two of five board members.
LWP-SURGE would use LWP’s real-time approval platform and SurgePays’ dealer network to operate a smartphone rent-to-own program.
No definitive agreements signed yet; LWP-SURGE has no operations or assets and formation alone is not expected to be material this quarter.
